headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightStepWidth_le_uniform
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L N hIn J hExit : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightStepWidth r c U L N hIn J hExit ≤
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.uniformStepWidth r c U L N hIn J hExit

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightUniformJoinedWord_split
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit : ℕ)
  (word : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightStepWidth r c U L N hIn J hExit) → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightUniformJoinedWord r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit word =
    have activeWord := OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.prefixWord ⋯ word;
    have parts :=
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FairBits.splitWordEquiv (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.incomingWidth r c U L hr hc d N hIn)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightCommonExitWidth r c U L J hExit))
        activeWord;
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.commonExitDraw r c U L hr hc d J hExit
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightCommonExitWidth r c U L J hExit) ⋯
      (Math115.RationalClockStep.incomingStep r c U L hr hc d N hIn parts.1) parts.2

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightUniformJoinedWord_law
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N hIn J hExit : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.tightUniformJoinedWord r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit) =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.actualJoinedLaw r c U L hr hc d N hIn J hExit
